policy: A failure listed here stays fully visible in every log; it is excluded from the pass/fail verdict ONLY with the reproducible reason recorded. Any failure NOT listed here fails the triage step and CI. A listed test that starts passing is reported as a note and removed at the next review.

tests/unit/core/test_ward_kernel.py::tes.reason: Calls cluster_node_buckets() at its default dot precision tf32x3; AMD HIP's Triton compiler allows only ('ieee','bf16x3','bf16x6') and rejects compilation (gfx1151 has no tf32 tensor cores). NVIDIA-only by construction.
tests/unit/core/test_ward_kernel.py::tes.evidence: AssertionError: input_precision must be one of ('ieee', 'bf16x3', 'bf16x6'). Got tf32x3 (triton CompilationError)
tests/unit/core/test_ward_kernel.py::tes.port_coverage: The same Ward kernels run at precision='ieee' in this port; gates A/A2 verify exact partition/pairing equality against the torch oracle on this GPU.

tests/unit/core/test_ward_kernel.py::tes.reason: Explicitly compares ward_merge() at default tf32x3 against precision='ieee'; the tf32x3 invocation cannot compile on HIP.
tests/unit/core/test_ward_kernel.py::tes.evidence: AssertionError: input_precision must be one of ('ieee', 'bf16x3', 'bf16x6'). Got tf32x3
tests/unit/core/test_ward_kernel.py::tes.port_coverage: tf32x3 is a NVIDIA fast-path this port replaces with 'ieee' (PORT_NOTES: HIP dot precisions).

tests/unit/core/test_shape_kernels.py::t.reason: Marginal RDNA numerics of the bf16 power-iteration kernel vs the fp64-ish torch eigh reference: one variance element misses the rtol 1e-3 tolerance by ~7x (measured rel 7.07e-3 at index (33,1)). Compiles and runs on gfx1151; only the NVIDIA-calibrated tolerance is exceeded. The shaped-bucket scoring path this tests is NOT used by this port (unshaped buckets).
tests/unit/core/test_shape_kernels.py::t.evidence: Mismatched elements: 2/128; greatest rel difference 0.007074519991874695 at (33,1) (up to 0.001 allowed)
tests/unit/core/test_shape_kernels.py::t.port_coverage: None needed: the port never builds shape tables. ROADMAP Track 2 item 6 tracks re-derived tolerances before enabling shaped scoring.
